meta.name: Challenge Accepted
meta.description:
Challenge Accepted follows Michelle Khare as she attempts the world's most difficult lifestyles, stunts, and professions.

Shows: I Trained Like A Broadway Star For 6 Weeks, I Ran 7 Marathons in 7 Days on 7 Continents, I Tried Planning My Wedding In A Week, I Trained Like Miss USA For 60 Days, I Tried Fire Academy
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
